# @alxia/cache

> 标签: JavaScript

## 简介

HTTP response caching for alxia: TTL, stale-while-revalidate, one load for concurrent misses, tags, ETags — in memory, or in Redis with @alxia/redis

## 官网

- 源码仓库：git+https://github.com/softistx/alxia.git
- npm 页面：https://www.npmjs.com/package/@alxia/cache
